hack.root_cause: Compound V2 empty-market donation attack — permissionless governance execution + exchange rate manipulation
hack.description: Sonne Finance lost $20M to the exact same Compound V2 donation attack that hit Hundred Finance a year earlier, after their own auditor explicitly flagged the vulnerability as high-severity.
